description: Implement the complete approved Story-Aware Dynamic Validation plan from 2026-08-18. This successor replaces documentation-only zombie B-38b7 and delivers DYN-1 through DYN-5. Reuse needs a current certified source closure and admissible signed per-command PASS receipt.
